page_title: PSG 2-0 LEN | PSG v Lens 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Joao Neves (PSG) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
89' A cross from Anthony Bermont (Lens) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
87' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
85' Rayan Fofana (Lens) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
84' Anthony Bermont (Lens) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post.
81' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the corner but it's cleared.
80' It is time for a substitution. Anthony Bermont (Lens) is on for Matthieu Udol.
80' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
75' Florian Thauvin (Lens) plays a lovely through ball to Rayan Fofana, but he can't beat Lucas Chevalier and loses the ball.
74' Senny Mayulu (PSG) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Zaire-Emery leaves the pitch and Joao Neves (PSG) comes on.
71' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Bradley Barcola and he is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
71' Luis Enrique is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Lucas Beraldo (PSG) suffers an injury and Nuno Mendes comes on.
68' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
67' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
66' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Rayan Fofana (Lens) replaces Odsonne Edouard.
66' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Aguilar.
63' Vitinha (PSG) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
62' Senny Mayulu (PSG) produces a killer pass onto Goncalo Ramos, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
59' A quickly taken corner by Lens.

58' A snap shot by Florian Thauvin (Lens) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Lucas Chevalier flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Lens.
57' Kang-In Lee is substituted due to injury. Luis Enrique gives a chance to Senny Mayulu (PSG).
56' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! Vitinha tees up Bradley Barcola (PSG) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
46' Half-time substitution. Pierre Sage decided to make a change. Morgan Guilavogui is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+4' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Risser pulls off a comfortable save.
45+3' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Lucas Chevalier (PSG).
45+1' Florian Thauvin (Lens) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Florian Thauvin (Lens) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
44' The ball possession at the moment is 75:25.
39' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
37' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Matthieu Udol (Lens) brought his opponent down. PSG will take a free kick.

31' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Robin Risser anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
30' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye.
29' The resulting corner from Florian Thauvin (Lens) comes to nothing.
28' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) picks up an injury.
28' Florian Thauvin (Lens) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Lens will take a corner kick.
27' Kang-In Lee (PSG) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
23' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' What was Florian Thauvin (Lens) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Vitinha tees up Bradley Barcola (PSG) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Goncalo Ramos.

10' Lucas Chevalier pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Florian Thauvin (Lens) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
8' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) will take an indirect free kick from inside the box.

7' Bradley Barcola (PSG) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
6' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is able to continue to play.
5' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
3' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lens will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
